༄༅/ /rgya skad du bris pa'i yi ge'i klog thabs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgya skad du bris pa'i yi ge'i klog thabs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs bzhugs/

oṃ swa sti/ rgya skad du bris pa'i yi ge klog thabs/ 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs zhes bya ba/ gnyis su med par gsung ba sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ngag gi dbang phyug rab dgyes lha mor bcas/ /de la gus pas btud nas 'dir bshad bya/ /rags las ches rags 'di lta bu yang ni/ /byis pa rnams la nyer mkho yin phyir ro/ /'di na bod klog bslab pa'i rigs 'gre dang*/ /sngags bsdu sogs dang sngags klog sbrel ba las/ /nges med 'khrul gzhi byung ba'ang mang po mthong*/ /gzhan dag phal cher mun sprul bya ba byed/ /sngags klog yi ge sngon chad byung ba rnams/ /phal cher gcig gcig phan tshul bris bshus nyid/ /de dag ji bzhin yin par ma mthong nas/ /'phags yul sgra mkhan mkhas pa'i ngag bzhin 'dri/ /dang por yi ge'i rtsa ba dbyangs gsal la/ /rgya klog lugs bzhin shes pa gal re che/ /oṃ dang na maḥ sid+dhaṃ sngon 'gro ba'i/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed rdzogs par bris byas la/ /dang po drug la ring thung 'byed pa gces/ /dbyangs ṛ rir dang dbri la 'dra min dang*/ /dbyangs l̥ lil dang lir zhes bya ba ste/ /e dang o ni e'i o'o zhes pa dang*/ /gnyis brtsegs a yo zhes dang a 'ur 'bod/ tha ma zung mi ang dang a ha te/ /gsal byed sde pa lnga yi gsum pa rnams/ /'as 'phul bzhin du klog par grags pa nyid/ /cud zad 'thug dang sde ba'i bzhi pa rnams/ phal cher gsum par mgo can dang mtshungs/ /dper na dang po'i bzhi pa ha yi sgra/ /cung zad yod pa'i sa dang rga 'dra'i 'thus/ /nya ni sna nas lhag par 'don pa dang*/ /nga ni rkan gyi sbugs nas cung zad sgrog /mthar gnas dang po'i dza dang phal cher 'dra/ /phyed ni yar 'bod bzhi pa 'bab zhes klog /de yi phyed ni wa skyes thog ma'i yin/ /wa chen bris kyang 'ba' ru 'bod pa mang*/ /tha dang bya bas mthar gnas sde bar dbye/ /dro ba'i gnyis pa kha mtshungs rkan nas sgyur/ /mthar zad khya dang 'dra rung so rtsa nas/

/lce rtsa can ni ka ka dang a ga ka ste/ /mchu can pa yig drag po'am a ba pa'o/ /bod rnams ko ba po ba zhes su 'bod/ /de yi rigs pa kha dang la'ang bya/ /ka la dbyangs rnams zhugs gyur shes na ni/ /gzhan rnams rigs 'gre bde blag rtogs par 'gyur/ /ka ka' ki ki'i ku ku'u kir ki rir/ /ki la ki yul ka'i ka' ko'o ka'u gang ba ha/ /l̥ zhugs pa las yang na ki lir zhes pa'o/ /gong mthar mi 'byor rang skya thub pa yi/ /gsal byed 'dra dang mi 'dra gang brtsegs kyang*/ /phal cher steng rnams sgra thon myur bar klag / rig byed las byung yi ge'i rnam grangs dang*/ /lha yi sa bon rigs la der ma nges/ /sgra 'dres la ni dbyangs rnams gnyis ka dbang*/ /ya ra wa rnams btags na sgra 'dres te/ mi 'dren na ni 'og ma dbang ba'ang yod/ /sto la sa toṣ+tuṃ la ṣa ṭu bzhin/ /'og ma dbang na gong ma ring por 'don/ /tshig mtshams min na gong gi mthar 'byor ba/ /phal cher mtha' brten tshul du sbyor ba mang*/ /dz+nya dang mthar zad brjod tshul 'gyur ches pas/ /gnyis ka byed mod ming gzhan la mi sbyor/ /dza la nya dang ṇa btags 'gya yin no/ /mthar brten tshul gyi srog med yi ge las/ /nya ṇa na 'dra sna sgra phra ba'i khyad/ /ka ni ga dang pa ni ba 'dra grim/ /tsa tsha dza dang ṭa ta rnams ni/ /da mtshungs sha ṣa gnyis ni sa 'dra las/ /de kun rang rang sgra thon tsam du bya/ kha tha pha sde ba'i bzhi pa dang*/ /ya wa ha spangs mthar rten yi ger 'byung/ tsha ni tsar 'gyur ḍa yang nyung ba yin/ / mtha' brten phal cher bod las shugs cher bya/ /ming gi dbus mtha'i gsum pa bod bzhin te/ /'di la nyer sgyur rkang tshugs ming dang mnyam/ /'on kyang skad dod ma shes 'di mi go /ka kha ga gsum ya btags bod dang mtshungs/ /gzhan rnams 'greng bu can 'dra ya sgra ldan/ /wa btags wa sgra ldan pa'i rna rung mtshungs/ /brtsegs pa'i nga ro 'og ma dbang ba ste/ /rang dbang can la sde pa rang rang gi

/lnga pa nyid de ya sogs brgyad la nga*/ /pha rol gsal byed dang 'brel pha rol dbang*/ /dbyangs rkyang la ni phal cher nga ru 'bod/ /gzungs dang snying po sa bon man ngag bzhin/ /phyag 'tshal bstod pa'i oṃ yig tshig grogs gtso/ /rnam bcad a mtha' drag po ha sgra can/ /iṛ l̥ la hi dang u la hu/ /lhag ma he hi ho hu phyogs mtshungs la/ /skyur thabs drag por 'phang ba bcad pa'i don/ /nga ro rnam bcad yod kyang sha ṣa sa/ /srog med yi ge snga ma'i mthar sbyor yod/ /shar nub sa mgo a yig zla thabs snon/ /dbus dang lho ba so sor phral te klog /mthar gnas thog mtha' ming thog 'dza 'ba' dang*/ mtha' ma ya wa mang ste nges bral dbus/ /rnam bcad nga ro 'dzom na h+ya gi sgra/ briṃḥl pri h+yaṃ 'dra rung brjod pa yin/ /a i u ṛ l̥ dang e sogs bzhi/ dbyangs kyi rtsa ba dgu yin gsal byed la/ /nga ro rnam bcad lce rtsa mchu can bzhi/ bsnan pas sum cu bdun du'ang 'gyur bar bshad/ /dang po'i dbyangs bzhi thung ring shin tu ring*/ /lir la ring dang e sogs thung ngu med/ /bod skad e sogs thung ngur mngon pas nas/ /oṃ sogs rna ru brtsegs ma can min te/ /ke sha can du go byed ma yin no/ /'a 'dags mi 'gal a sogs dang mtshungs phyir/ /de ltar dbyangs yig nyi shu rtsa gnyis la/ skad gdangs mtho dma' bar gsum dbye ba dang*/ /de yang sna ldan sna med dbye ba yis/ /brgya dang so gnyis dbyangs kyi dbye ba ste/ /gsal byed sum cu gsum la dbyangs de rnams/ / zhugs pas bzhi stong sum brgya nga drug go /yi ge brtsegs dang ngo ro sogs dbye ba/ /yi ge'i rab dbye mtha' yas sus brjod nus/ /klus bkod gzhung las de ltar 'byung ba yin/ /li la du klog nas li la'ang ring po byed/ nga ro la sogs dbyangs min gsal byed min/ /lha yi gzhung la de ltar 'byung bar mngon/ /a ku ha ྈྐ mgrin 'byung nam mkha'i khams/ /i tsu ya sha rlung khams kun las byung*/

ri ṭu ra ṣa me khams spyi bo skyes/ u pu waྉྤ mchu las skyes pa chu/ /l̥ tu la sa sa khams so skye te/ /mthar gnas har tsas dbyangs skyes ya ṇar bskyur/ /nga ro rnam bcad gsal byed las byung dang*/ /lce rtsa mchu can rnam bcad las byung zer/ /dbyangs dgu'i dang po lnga po rtsa ba dang*/ /yon tan a e o ar al yin te/ /ā dang ai sogs 'phel ba yin par 'dod/ /ring po ches ring 'greng bu rna ru dang*/ /rnam bcad nga ro can dang mthar can sogs/ rang dbang brtsegs ma lci ste gzhan rnams yang*/ /sde pa'i bzhi pa 'thug dang gsum pa srab/ /brda sprod pa dag yi ge byed po zhes/ /lta ba'i thibs bor chud pa rab spangs te/ /rnam 'dren lugs la rten 'brel kho na nyid/ /de ni sgra spyi snang ba'i shes pa ste/ /sgra rtog 'jug pa gcig pa'i 'brel ba las/ /bde sdug dge dang mi dge las byed pa/ /'di tsam zhig ni dpag par bya ba yin/ /thun mong rig gnas phra mo 'chad pa'i skabs/ /sngags kyi theg par rlom pa'i cal col gtam/ /smra ba de ni gsang sgrogs spus kyis nyo/ /mkhas 'dod thal bas blun po'i rang rtags bstan/ /yi ge'i rnam par bzhag pa gzhan gar zhig /rgya bod mkhas la grags pa ches mang mod/ /rgya skad yi ge klog thabs tsam zhig 'dir/ /bris pa 'di yang gzhan la phan phyir yin/ /zhes pa rgya skad du bris pa'i yi ge klog thabs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs 'di yang tā ra nā thas smras pa'o/ /dar rgyas 'phel brtan/ gcig zhus dag// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/ rgya skad du bris pa'i yi ge'i klog thabs 'phags yul mkhas pa'i lugs bzhugs/ - PAGE 646 -- PAGE 647 -- PAGE 643 -
